meta_description:
15K likes, 143 comments - anoushkalila on September 25, 2026: "The most beautiful place in England at the most beautiful time of year 🍂

On paper, I feel I should hate The Cotswolds. It’s touristy, it’s busy, it’s extremely hyped, it’s expensive (looking at you, Daylesford). And yet, it is simply so wonderfully pretty that all those things cease to matter. Particularly in Autumn (okay I squeezed in a couple of Spring snaps too, but shhh, don’t tell), when the leaves turn brown and the ivy glows red, it is a visual feast. And getting all cosy next to a roaring pub fire with a Sunday roast and all the trimmings? About as perfect as it gets. 

If you’re planning a Cotswolds trip, here’s a shortlist of the towns and villages I’d recommend putting on your itinerary:

- Castle Combe 
- Bibury
- Lower Slaughter 
- Chipping Campden 
- Bourton-on-the-water 
- Stow-on-the-Wold
- Burford
- Snowshill 
- Tetbury
- Painswick
- Broadway

A quick Autumnal Cotswolds 101

- The best time to go to see Autumn colour is usually the end of October and beginning of November, however this can vary year by year depending on the climate
- It’s doable by public transport, but I’d recommend driving if you can
- Stay in local village B&Bs, or book a stay at the Cluedo Manor-worthy @themanor_house 
- Combine with a trip to nearby Bath, Bristol, or Oxford
- If you do one thing, make it a classic Sunday pub roast
